companyCategories.description: Match Wellfound market, industry and company-type tags or the company high concept. This is not a company-name filter; use includeCompanies for names. Requires enrichDetails=true.
companyCategories.title: Company Categories

companySizes.description: Keep jobs or companies whose company size matches one of these values, for example 11-50, 51-200 or SIZE_51_200. Rows without a size are dropped and counted.
companySizes.title: Company Sizes

companyStages.description: Keep jobs or companies whose stage matches one of these values, for example seed, early-stage, growth-stage or scale-stage. Rows without a stage are dropped and counted.
companyStages.title: Company Stages

enrichDetails.description: Fetch plain and autoOpen detail pages for selected jobs to add description HTML, structured salary/equity, visa/relocation, skills, company funding, founders, socials and benefits. Direct job URLs are always enriched. Default true; the saved prefill turns it off to keep scheduled runs fast.
enrichDetails.title: Enrich Job Details

equityOnly.description: Keep jobs that explicitly offer equity; jobs that say No equity or do not mention equity are dropped.
equityOnly.title: Equity Only

excludeCompanies.description: Drop jobs whose company name or slug contains one of these values. Exclusions win over includeCompanies.
excludeCompanies.title: Exclude Companies

expandSimilar.description: Add related jobs from the autoOpen detail page similarJobs edges, bounded by similarDepth and similarLimit. Only applies to job modes.
expandSimilar.title: Expand Similar Jobs

experience.description: Best-effort filter: title keywords first, then yearsExperienceMin (0-2 junior, 3-4 mid, 5+ senior). Unknown jobs are kept and counted.
experience.title: Experience Level

includeCompanies.description: Only keep jobs whose company name or slug contains one of these values (case-insensitive).
includeCompanies.title: Include Companies

includeNoSalary.description: Only applies when minSalary or maxSalary is set. When false, jobs with no parsed salary are dropped.
includeNoSalary.title: Include Jobs Without Salary Data

jobTitle.description: Only keep jobs whose title contains this phrase (case-insensitive).
jobTitle.title: Job Title Filter

jobType.description: Exact structured job type from Wellfound. Jobs with a missing/unknown type are dropped when a specific type is selected.
jobType.title: Job Type

keyword.description: Only keep jobs matching this text across title, company, locations, compensation and description (case-insensitive).
keyword.title: Keyword

location.description: Used as a server-side /location/{location} or /role/l/{role}/{location} path when it is a clean city slug or name, and always as a case-insensitive client filter over locations and accepted remote locations.
location.title: Location

maxEquity.description: Keep jobs whose equity range bottom is at or below this percentage. 0 = unlimited.
maxEquity.title: Maximum Equity

maxItems.description: Maximum jobs or companies pushed after all filters and sorting.
maxItems.title: Max Items

maxSalary.description: Keep jobs whose salary range bottom is at or below this amount. 0 = unlimited. This is the documented range-start semantics.
maxSalary.title: Maximum Salary

minCompanyFunding.description: Keep jobs whose parsed total funding is at or above this amount. Requires detail enrichment; unknown funding is dropped. 0 = off.
minCompanyFunding.title: Minimum Company Funding

minEquity.description: Keep jobs whose equity range top is at or above this percentage. Jobs without equity data are dropped. 0 = off.
minEquity.title: Minimum Equity

minOpenJobs.description: Keep rows whose company open-job count is at or above this value. Requires detail enrichment for jobs; unknown counts are dropped. 0 = off.
minOpenJobs.title: Minimum Open Jobs

minSalary.description: Keep jobs whose salary range top is at or above this amount. Currency is the job's listed currency; no FX conversion. 0 = off.
minSalary.title: Minimum Salary

mode.description: Auto uses startUrls when provided, otherwise role/location search. Search ignores startUrls. Scrape URLs requires at least one start URL. Companies reads the /startups directory.
mode.title: Scraping Mode

onlyNew.description: Push only jobs or companies whose IDs have not been seen for this stateKey. Requires stateKey.
onlyNew.title: Only New Items

pageLimit.description: 0 fetches every page up to pageCount. N fetches the first N pages. An explicit ?page=N start URL fetches only that page.
pageLimit.title: Page Limit

postedWithinDays.description: Keep jobs posted within the last N days. Jobs without a parsed posted date are dropped and counted. 0 = off.
postedWithinDays.title: Posted Within Days

remoteOnly.description: Search /remote or /role/r/{role} and keep only jobs flagged as remote.
remoteOnly.title: Remote Only

remoteWfhFlexible.description: Keep jobs whose remote configuration explicitly reports work-from-home flexibility. Requires detail enrichment; unknown values are dropped.
remoteWfhFlexible.title: Remote / WFH Flexible

role.description: Wellfound role slug for search mode, for example software-engineer, product-manager, designer or machine-learning-engineer.
role.title: Role

salaryCurrency.description: Filter parsed salaries by currency. No FX conversion is performed.
salaryCurrency.title: Salary Currency

similarDepth.description: 1 emits the similar jobs embedded in the enriched page. 2-3 follow additional autoOpen pages within similarLimit.
similarDepth.title: Similar Depth

similarLimit.description: Maximum additional similar jobs emitted per run, also bounded by maxItems.
similarLimit.title: Similar Limit

sort.description: none keeps first-seen source order. newest/oldest sort the whole run by parsed posted date; jobs without a date are last.
sort.title: Sort Order

startUrls.description: Jobs: /jobs, /role/{role}, /role/l/{role}/{location}, /role/r/{role}, /location/{location}, /remote, /jobs/{id}-{slug} and /job-collections/{slug}. Companies: /startups, /startups/location/{location} and /startups/industry/{industry}. Company profile and login URLs are rejected.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

stateKey.description: Persistent key in the wellfound-monitor key-value store used to remember seen job/company IDs between runs. Changing it starts a fresh history.
stateKey.title: State Key

visaSponsorshipOnly.description: Keep jobs whose detail page says visa sponsorship is available. Requires detail enrichment; unknown values are dropped.
visaSponsorshipOnly.title: Visa Sponsorship Only

ycOnly.description: Keep rows where the YC Funded badge is present.
ycOnly.title: YC Funded Only
